entries.subject: release
entries.title: Release 0.1.0
entries.passMark: @kbui/react and @kbui/css install from their release tarballs, type-check and pass a smoke run on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows
entries.summary: The first release installs and passes a quick check on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.

entries.subject: ci-main
entries.title: Every check passes on main
entries.passMark: Every step of the ci workflow passes on main
entries.summary: Every automated check on the main branch passes, including unit, packaging and component tests.

measured.label: Unit tests
measured.value: 19 tokens, 11 css, 48 react, 18 scripts and fixtures; all passed

entries.subject: m0-foundation
entries.title: Foundation
entries.passMark: Every package builds, every component has an anatomy line, story and test, every story passes the accessibility scan, a release installs on three operating systems, and CI passes on main
entries.summary: Tokens, CSS and 13 React components are released together, with every check passing.

measured.label: Components
measured.value: 13, each with an anatomy line, story and test

measured.label: Unit tests at d812777
measured.value: 31 tokens, 16 css, 72 react, 18 scripts; all passed

entries.subject: m1-first-product-screen
entries.title: A first product screen
entries.passMark: One real product screen built on kbui is merged in its own repository with its checks passing, by 2026-11-02
entries.summary: A real product screen is built on kbui 0.4.0 and passes its checks; it is not merged yet.

measured.label: Product screen
measured.value: Built on kbui 0.4.0 components, in review

entries.subject: m2-field-test
entries.title: Field test
entries.passMark: Violation shares by rule family, a speed baseline and per-rule precision on 50 labeled screens are recorded for 30 prompts on json-render with the shadcn catalog
entries.summary: Will check whether screens from today's UI generators still break design and safety rules.

entries.subject: m3-catalog
entries.title: More components and layout
entries.passMark: At least 30 catalog entries, each with an anatomy line, story, test and screenshot; layout intents collapse correctly at three widths; accessibility scan clean in light and dark
entries.summary: Will add about 20 components and layout building blocks, enough to compose real screens.

entries.subject: m4-contract-catalog
entries.title: One source for agents and components
entries.passMark: The manifest regenerates byte for byte, a deliberate component and entry mismatch fails the drift test, and the exported schema accepts every catalog example and rejects a seeded invalid tree
entries.summary: Will generate what AI agents read about kbui from the same definitions the components use.

entries.subject: m5-rule-engine
entries.title: Rules that check screens
entries.passMark: A deliberately bad screen is flagged and fixed with no model call, every story passes the rules, each rule scores at least 0.7 precision, and seeded violations are caught
entries.summary: Will check and fix screens for safety, structure, design, layout and data fit.

entries.subject: m6-render-measure
entries.title: Render and measure
entries.passMark: test:gen results are committed and reproduce with one command, every component has selection prompts with a recorded pass rate, and every stage reports its catch rate and cost
entries.summary: Will render generated screens and measure quality, speed and cost at every stage.

entries.subject: m7-preference
entries.title: Do people prefer it?
entries.passMark: At least 37 wins in 60 blind pairs against json-render with the shadcn catalog
entries.summary: Will test whether people prefer screens checked and fixed by kbui over a leading alternative.

entries.subject: m8-one-bar
entries.title: The same rules for every source
entries.passMark: One screen as a story, agent TSX, an A2UI tree and a json-render tree gets the same lint result; adapter fixtures validate upstream; the canary is green two weeks running
entries.summary: Will apply the same rules to hand-written code, coding agents and other generators' formats.

entries.subject: m9-edits-nesting
entries.title: Edit one part of a screen, and nest other apps
entries.passMark: At least 80% of edit prompts apply as patches without regenerating, and lint rejects a foreign surface in a slot that does not allow one
entries.summary: Will let people change one part of a screen without regenerating it, and nest other apps safely.

entries.subject: m10-promotion
entries.title: Saved screens become components
entries.passMark: A saved composition becomes a manifest pattern the model reuses, and promoting it generates a component, story and test that pass every check
entries.summary: Will turn screens people save into reusable patterns and real components.
